# Fuel System Cleaning Kits and Products

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Tap into the fuel rail to inject cleaner directly onto the injectors and disable the main fuel pump. [t2949]

[Partial] Run a drip process through a vacuum line positioned as close to the throttle body as possible using a 3M Fuel System Tune-Up Kit. [t2949]

Apply BG 44k cleaner to the fuel system every six months. [t2949]

[Partial] Add a chemical cleaner directly into the fuel tank. [t2949]
